name: kubeflow-central-dashboard
description: Single UI for Pipelines and other Kubeflow components. Enable Kubeflow Platform first for SSO.
overview:
**What it is** — Kubeflow Central Dashboard is the home page for Kubeflow
component UIs. Login and routing come from **Kubeflow Platform**

**Highlights**
- Single UI for discovering enabled Kubeflow components
- Baked VirtualService sends `/` through Platform's oauth2-proxy
- Tunable resources/replicas/scheduling via `configOverrides` (Helm-chart backed)

**Prerequisites**
- **Kubeflow Platform** (required) — enable it with
  `config.kubeflowIngressHost` first. Without Platform there is no SSO
  entry point; baked routes expect `oauth2-proxy`.
- **istio-helm** (required) — VirtualService / AuthorizationPolicy.
- **Namespace** — Workloads land in `kubeflow-central-dashboard`

**Access** — Open the Platform LoadBalancer URL at `/` (the same host as
Pipelines at `/pipeline/`). Do not port-forward `svc/centraldashboard`:
that skips oauth2-proxy, so the dashboard has no `kubeflow-userid`.

**Documentation:** [Kubeflow Central Dashboard](https://www.kubeflow.org/docs/components/central-dash/) | **Project:** [kubeflow/manifests](https://github.com/kubeflow/manifests)
